title: Counting Sort Placement Loop
statement: The placement step of counting sort loops over all $n$ input items. For each item, it reads the current placement value from the count cell indexed by the item's key, writes the item from the source array to the destination array at that position, and increments the placement value by one.
caveat: The formal statement omits definitions of the loop, memory notation, and variable addresses, so the exact cell addresses and iteration bounds cannot be stated confidently.
